import heapq

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.N = size
        self.edge_list = []
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(size)]

    def add(self, u, v, cap, w):
        idx = len(self.edge_list)
        self.edge_list.append((u, len(self.adj[u])))
        self.adj[u].append(self._Edge(v, len(self.adj[v]), cap, w))
        self.adj[v].append(self._Edge(u, len(self.adj[u]) - 1, 0, -w))
        return idx

    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, src, dst, cap, flow, cost):
            self.src = src
            self.dst = dst
            self.cap = cap
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

    def get(self, i):
        u, pos = self.edge_list[i]
        f = self.adj[u][pos]
        r = self.adj[f.dst][f.rev]
        return self.Edge(u, f.dst, f.cap + r.cap, r.cap, f.cost)

    def list_edges(self):
        res = []
        for i in range(len(self.edge_list)):
            u, pos = self.edge_list[i]
            f = self.adj[u][pos]
            r = self.adj[f.dst][f.rev]
            res.append(self.Edge(u, f.dst, f.cap + r.cap, r.cap, f.cost))
        return res

    def _refine(self, s, t):
        self.d = [4294967295] * self.N
        self.par = [-1] * self.N
        self.par_edge = [-1] * self.N
        self.seen = [False] * self.N
        heap = [s]
        self.d[s] = 0
        while heap:
            v = heapq.heappop(heap) & 4294967295
            if self.seen[v]:
                continue
            self.seen[v] = True
            if v == t:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.adj[v])):
                e = self.adj[v][i]
                if self.seen[e.to] or e.cap == 0:
                    continue
                rc = e.cost - self.phi[e.to] + self.phi[v]
                if self.d[e.to] > self.d[v] + rc:
                    self.d[e.to] = self.d[v] + rc
                    self.par[e.to] = v
                    self.par_edge[e.to] = i
                    heapq.heappush(heap, ((self.d[e.to] << 32) + e.to))
        if not self.seen[t]:
            return False
        for i in range(self.N):
            if not self.seen[i]:
                continue
            self.phi[i] -= self.d[t] - self.d[i]
        return True

    def frontier(self, s, t, limit=4294967295):
        self.phi = [0] * self.N
        self.d = [4294967295] * self.N
        self.par = [-1] * self.N
        self.par_edge = [-1] * self.N
        self.seen = [False] * self.N
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        last_cost = -1
        points = [(flow, cost)]
        while flow < limit:
            if not self._refine(s, t):
                break
            c = limit - flow
            v = t
            while v != s:
                c = min(c, self.adj[self.par[v]][self.par_edge[v]].cap)

            v = t

                v = self.par[v]

            flow += c

                points.pop()
            points.append((flow, cost))
            last_cost = d
        return points

    def send(self, s, t, limit=4294967295):

            self.to = to

            self.cap = cap

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Graph {
        static class Edge {
            int src, dst, cap, flow, cost;
            Edge(int src, int dst, int cap, int flow, int cost) {
                this.src = src;
                this.dst = dst;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        static class _Edge {
            int to, rev, cap, cost;
            _Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        int N;
        List<int[]> edge_list;
        List<List<_Edge>> adj;

        Graph(int size) {
            N = size;
            edge_list = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        int add(int u, int v, int cap, int w) {
            int idx = edge_list.size();
            edge_list.add(new int[]{u, adj.get(u).size()});
            adj.get(u).add(new _Edge(v, adj.get(v).size(), cap, w));
            adj.get(v).add(new _Edge(u, adj.get(u).size() - 1, 0, -w));
            return idx;
        }

        Edge get(int i) {
            int[] ep = edge_list.get(i);
            int u = ep[0], pos = ep[1];
            _Edge f = adj.get(u).get(pos);
            _Edge r = adj.get(f.to).get(f.rev);
            return new Edge(u, f.to, f.cap + r.cap, r.cap, f.cost);
        }

        List<Edge> list_edges() {
            List<Edge> res = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < edge_list.size(); i++) {
                int[] ep = edge_list.get(i);
                int u = ep[0], pos = ep[1];
                _Edge f = adj.get(u).get(pos);
                _Edge r = adj.get(f.to).get(f.rev);
                res.add(new Edge(u, f.to, f.cap + r.cap, r.cap, f.cost));
            }
            return res;
        }

        boolean[] seen;
        int[] d, par, par_edge, phi;

        boolean _refine(int s, int t) {
            d = new int[N];
            par = new int[N];
            par_edge = new int[N];
            seen = new boolean[N];
            phi = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(d, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(par, -1);
            Arrays.fill(par_edge, -1);
            Arrays.fill(seen, false);

            PriorityQueue<int[]> heap = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Integer.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            d[s] = 0;
            heap.offer(new int[]{0, s});

            while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
                int[] cur = heap.poll();
                int v = cur[1];
                if (seen[v]) continue;
                seen[v] = true;
                if (v == t) break;

                for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(v).size(); i++) {
                    _Edge e = adj.get(v).get(i);
                    if (seen[e.to] || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    int rc = e.cost - (phi[e.to] - phi[v]);
                    if (d[e.to] > d[v] + rc) {
                        d[e.to] = d[v] + rc;
                        par[e.to] = v;
                        par_edge[e.to] = i;
                        heap.offer(new int[]{d[e.to], e.to});
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!seen[t]) return false;

            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                if (seen[i]) {
                    phi[i] -= (d[t] - d[i]);
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        List<int[]> frontier(int s, int t, int limit) {
            d = new int[N];
            par = new int[N];
            par_edge = new int[N];
            seen = new boolean[N];
            phi = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(d, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(par, -1);
            Arrays.fill(par_edge, -1);
            Arrays.fill(seen, false);

            int flow = 0;
            int cost = 0;
            int last_cost = -1;
            List<int[]> points = new ArrayList<>();
            points.add(new int[]{flow, cost});

            while (flow < limit) {
                if (!_refine(s, t)) break;

                int c = limit - flow;
                int v = t;
                while (v != s) {
                    c = Math.min(c, adj.get(par[v]).get(par_edge[v]).cap);
                    v = par[v];
                }

                v = t;
                while (v != s) {
                    _Edge e = adj.get(par[v]).get(par_edge[v]);
                    e.cap -= c;
                    adj.get(v).get(e.rev).cap += c;
                    v = par[v];
                }

                int dd = -phi[s];
                flow += c;
                cost += c * dd;

                if (last_cost == dd) {
                    points.remove(points.size() - 1);
                }
                points.add(new int[]{flow, cost});
                last_cost = dd;
            }
            return points;
        }

        int[] send(int s, int t, int limit) {
            List<int[]> res = frontier(s, t, limit);
            int[] last = res.get(res.size() - 1);
            return new int[]{last[0], last[1]};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int a1 = sc.nextInt();
        int a2 = sc.nextInt();
        int a3 = sc.nextInt();
        int b1 = sc.nextInt();
        int b2 = sc.nextInt();
        int b3 = sc.nextInt();

        Graph g = new Graph(8);
        g.add(0, 1, a1, 0);
        g.add(0, 2, a2, 0);
        g.add(0, 3, a3, 0);
        g.add(4, 7, b1, 0);
        g.add(5, 7, b2, 0);
        g.add(6, 7, b3, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
                int cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
                g.add(i, j, Integer.MAX_VALUE, cost);
            }
        }

        int[] res = g.send(0, 7, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        int ans1 = res[1];
        int ans2 = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
        System.out.println(ans1 + " " + ans2);
    }
}
